## Workload

During the quarter, grader Tomas Brennan completed 859 reads over 450 hours. This represents an average of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review as part of the quarterly grading assessment. The volume of work and time recorded provide the basis for considering both output and the quality review results.

## Quality

A sample of 67 reads was checked. Agreement was recorded at 56.7 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent assessment and identify areas requiring attention. The review considered the checked reads alongside the overall workload completed during the quarter.

The assessment was reviewed by Priya Anand.
